name: SVC_STANDARD_TEXT_B
description: This is the base table for the Standard Text which is defined in the Translation table.

columns.name: STD_TXT_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: STD_TXT_NUMBER
columns.description: STD_TXT_NUMBER. This is a public surrogate key.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STDTXT_NAME
columns.description: Short descriptive name for the Standard Text. This is searchable through the UI and indexed .

columns.name: STD_TXT_UNIQUE_NUMBER
columns.description: STD_TXT_UNIQUE_NUMBER. This is a public surrogate key which is required during creation of the row.

columns.name: HTML_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N flag to indicate if the standard text is rich text or plain text. Default is N.

columns.name: FOLDER_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to assign the Standard Text to a folder

columns.name: SCOPE
columns.description:
Global, User, Role
If the scope is User then the USER_ID must contain the FK value.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This must contain the FK value when scope is set to User.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Enable or Disable the Standard Text. This will allow control if the Standard Text can be used by the users. Default is Y

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start Date as of when the text can be used by the users. Default is sysdate.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Final date when the text can be used by the users.

columns.name: DOMAIN
columns.description: Domain or Category for the SmartText.

columns.name: SUB_DOMAIN
columns.description: Sub Domain for the SmartText.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.

columns.name: OBJECT
columns.description: This is the primary object the SmartText is used for .

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Stores the Business Unit Org Id of the SmartText.
